provincial.name: Manitoba Supports for Persons with Disabilities (MSPD)
provincial.who: Manitobans with severe and prolonged disabilities; some instantly eligible, others apply (detail on eligibility page, not fetched)
provincial.what: Disability income support with enhanced benefits, replacing EIA disability stream
provincial.notes: Page says effective April 1, 2023; thin content. Search summaries (not official fetch): auto-entry for EIA-disability clients also on Community Living, personal care home or CPP-D. eligibility.html URL 404'd, so detailed criteria unverified. EIA disability page (eia_disability.html) cites ~$1,314/month single as of July 2026 but not clearly MSPD.

provincial.name: Employment and Income Assistance (EIA) - Disability / general
provincial.who: Live in Manitoba and in financial need; disability stream: 18+, disability likely >1 year preventing earning basic needs
provincial.what: Monthly basic needs, Rent Assist, health items, basic dental/optical/drug, employment supports
provincial.notes: Dental change: after Sept 1, 2026 EIA pays only dental emergencies; must apply for federal CDCP; new EIA clients after April 1, 2026 pay non-emergency dental. Disability page also lists Northern Allowance, voluntary employment services with child care/transport/work-expense help, single grants. Overlap with MSPD.

provincial.name: Rewarding Work Health Plan
provincial.who: Eligible EIA clients and their children who move from EIA to work or training
provincial.what: Prescription drug, dental and optical coverage up to two years
provincial.notes: Seen only as a paragraph on the EIA disability page; no dedicated page fetched. Dental portion affected by Sept 2026 change.

provincial.name: Rent Assist (non-EIA)
provincial.who: 18+, citizen/PR, rent unsubsidized housing, below net income limit (single $29,120; 55+ or DTC/CPP-D $33,920; 2 people $38,720; 3-4 $50,240; 5+ $60,768)
provincial.what: Monthly shelter benefit up to 80% of median market rent
provincial.notes: DTC or CPP-D raises limit and benefit. Excludes Manitoba Housing renters, homeowners, EIA recipients (they get Rent Assist inside EIA). Search snippet showed lower older limits on another page; fetched page used.

provincial.name: Manitoba Pharmacare (income-based)
provincial.who: Manitoba Health coverage and prescriptions not covered by another provincial/federal program; any age
provincial.what: Drug coverage after annual income-based deductible
provincial.notes: Deductible Instalment Payment Program (https://gov.mb.ca/health/pharmacare/dippp.html) seen in search only, not fetched.

provincial.name: Manitoba Enhanced Pharmacare Program (MEPP)
provincial.who: Active Manitoba Health card and not eligible for 100% coverage elsewhere; no age limit
provincial.what: No-cost most medications for diabetes, birth control, HIV prevention/treatment, hormone therapy; dispensing fee up to $14
provincial.notes: Effective April 15, 2025. Condition-specific drug classes; diabetes meds relevant to disability only partly. Ozempic and diabetes supplies excluded. Probably borderline scope.

provincial.name: Disability and Health Supports Unit
provincial.who: People in EIA, Children's disABILITY Services or Community Living disABILITY Services with a diagnosed medical need
provincial.what: Health supplies, equipment and nutritional/diet supplements, delivered by province
provincial.notes: Requests via health professional; no separate income test on page.

provincial.name: Children's disABILITY Services (CDS)
provincial.who: Under 18 in Manitoba with diagnosed intellectual disability, developmental delay, autism, lifelong physical disability with mobility limits; First Nations on reserve eligible since Feb 4, 2025
provincial.what: Case worker, information, help arranging family supports (e.g. respite) to care for child at home
provincial.notes: Page does not list dollar supports; other pages (pwd hub) mention early intervention, autism services, respite.

provincial.name: Community Living disABILITY Services (CLDS)
provincial.who: Eligible adults with intellectual disabilities (criteria on separate page, not fetched)
provincial.what: Person-centred planning, info on services and funding, residential/day/home-based supports
provincial.notes: Eligibility page not fetched. Hub description lists residential, day, home-based, clinical and crisis supports.

provincial.name: Children Therapy Network of Manitoba
provincial.what: Speech-language, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, audiology for children
provincial.notes: Only seen as one-line hub listing on https://gov.mb.ca/fs/pwd/index.html; target page not fetched.

provincial.name: Manitoba Home Care (incl. Self and Family Managed Care)
provincial.who: Manitobans of any age with assessed need; regional health authority decides
provincial.what: Assessed home care services; paid family caregivers possible through Self and Family Managed Care
provincial.notes: SFMC criteria seen in search summary only (https://gov.mb.ca/health/homecare/nonprof.html listed, not fetched). No cost for eligible clients per search summary.

provincial.name: Manitoba Primary Caregiver Tax Credit
provincial.who: Unpaid caregiver (90+ days) of a person in a private residence assessed at home care level 2 or higher
provincial.what: Refundable $1,400 a year, not income tested
provincial.notes: Register online with Manitoba Finance; registration valid up to 3 years; one caregiver per recipient.

provincial.name: Manitoba Child Benefit
provincial.who: Manitoba families with children under 18, receiving Canada Child Benefit, with low income
provincial.what: Up to $420 per child per year tax-free
provincial.notes: Exact income cutoffs on linked table, not on fetched page. Excludes EIA unless health portion only. Includes Children's Opti-Care eyeglasses (search snippet only).

provincial.name: 55 PLUS (Manitoba Income Supplement for 55+)
provincial.who: Age 55+, Manitoba resident, valid Manitoba Health number, low income; OAS recipients assessed automatically
provincial.what: Quarterly payment up to $161.80 single / $173.90 per person in couple
provincial.notes: Search snippet noted April/July 2025 payment problems; fetched page showed no such notice. EIA recipients generally excluded.

provincial.name: Accessible Parking Permit Program (run by Manitoba Possible)
provincial.who: People unable to walk more than 50 metres unassisted without great difficulty; health professional applies
provincial.what: Accessible parking permit, $15, usable in any vehicle carrying the holder
provincial.notes: Regulated by Manitoba Transportation & Infrastructure; administered by Manitoba Possible (formerly Society for Manitobans with Disabilities; smd.mb.ca redirects). About 10 business days.

provincial.name: Homeowner Residential Adaptations for Disabilities (RAD)
provincial.who: Low-income homeowners living in the home, with a household member with a disability; property taxes current
provincial.what: Forgivable loan up to $16,000 ($19,000 north of 53rd parallel) for accessibility modifications
provincial.notes: Income limits on page dated Jan 1, 2019 (e.g. Winnipeg $40,500 no dependants / $54,000 with); confirm current. Excludes First Nations communities.

provincial.name: Manitoba Student Aid - disability supports
provincial.who: Students with verified permanent or persistent/prolonged disability
provincial.what: Access to Canada Student Grants for disabilities and services/equipment; exempt from fixed student contribution; 520-week lifetime limit
provincial.notes: Grants themselves are federal (overlap). Page lists no dollar amounts. Provincial Manitoba Bursary separate (search only).

provincial.name: Manitoba Housing accessible/adapted social housing
provincial.what: Adapted social housing units; visitability standard on assisted new builds
provincial.notes: Only the search snippet and URL seen; page not fetched. Seniors home modification grant (2023, 65+, $60,000 income) seen only in search summary; unverified if still open.

municipal.name: Winnipeg Transit Plus (paratransit)
municipal.who: People unable to regularly use fixed-route transit because of disability; criteria incl. wheelchair/scooter, cannot walk 175 m, legal blindness, dementia (search summary)
municipal.what: Door-to-door paratransit, whole city since Jan 1, 2021
municipal.notes: Fetched page lacks criteria; criteria from search summary of application pages. City drafted broader eligibility rules (Jan 2026 notice; council decision unconfirmed). Assessment backlog reported.

municipal.name: WINNpass (Winnipeg low-income transit pass)
municipal.who: Winnipeg residents 18-64 below LICO, on EIA, or newcomers under a year
municipal.what: Discounted monthly pass (50% per search; fetched page outdated, says 30%)
municipal.notes: Fetched page is stale; current page https://info.winnipegtransit.com/en/fares/winnpass appeared in search but was not fetched. Nov 2025 EIA circular (search only): EIA and MSPD recipients can apply unless transport already covered. Transit Plus customers can apply.

municipal.name: Winnipeg Recreation Fee Assistance Program
municipal.who: Winnipeg residents or newcomers with family income below LICO (1 person $31,264)
municipal.what: Facility pass, drop-in pass, $300 Leisure Guide credit per person
municipal.notes: Proof can be EIA case number, Notice of Assessment or CPP Disability statement.

municipal.name: Brandon Transit - Access Transit and Fares > Special Programs
municipal.what: Accessible service and special fare programs exist per menu
municipal.notes: Details not on fetched page; subpages not fetched. Free youth Ride Ready Pass from Sept 2026 (not income/disability).
